options.title: minimal_source_defined_or_unknown_contract
options.trade_off: highest determinism and lowest leakage risk but deliberately low analytical granularity
options.contingency: use different materials and keep all calibration rows hard-quarantined

options.title: rich_hierarchical_ontology
options.trade_off: greater analytical utility but higher ambiguity owner burden and overfitting risk
options.contingency: develop only after a separate source-independent ontology exercise establishes mappings

options.title: source_native_only_without_controlled_semantics
options.trade_off: strongest fidelity but insufficient interoperability for substantive semantic concordance
options.contingency: treat as ontology discovery rather than G2 evidence

options.title: relax_thresholds_or_adjudicate_after_extraction
options.trade_off: could create superficial agreement by weakening the claim
